claims.statement: The Northgate Business Park lease applies a controllable-expense cap of 5% per annum on operating expense reimbursements, calculated on a cumulative, compounding basis, as part of the triple-net reimbursement structure.

citations.quote: Tenant reimburses its pro rata share of operating expenses and real estate taxes on a triple-net basis, subject to a controllable-expense cap of 5% per annum on a cumulative, compounding basis.
